name: Emissary Taluun
summary: Emissary Taluun is an ambassador stationed within Stormwind Keep, representing his people before the leadership of the Kingdom of Stormwind. Residing in the Petitioner's Chamber, he acts as an official diplomatic voice in the heart of the Alliance capital. Travelers passing through the keep often consult him as a liaison on affairs abroad.

sections.title: Voice in the Petitioner's Chamber
sections.body: Situated in the Petitioner's Chamber just off the grand entrance of Stormwind Keep, Emissary Taluun handles diplomatic outreach between foreign representatives and the royal court. Accompanied by Farseer Umbrua, he observes courtly petitions and coordinates diplomatic ties across Alliance territories, directing emissaries and couriers to outlying settlements like Darkshire in Duskwood.

faq.answer: Emissary Taluun is a high-ranking diplomat stationed within the Petitioner's Chamber of Stormwind Keep. He serves as an ambassador liaising directly with the court of Stormwind.

faq.q: Where can I find Emissary Taluun?
faq.answer: He is located in Stormwind Keep in the Petitioner's Chamber, the first room on the left upon entering through the keep's primary entrance.
Emissary Taluun brought Farseer Umbrua with him to Stormwind City, where they both remain stationed to handle diplomatic matters.

faq.q: What matters does he oversee for adventurers?
faq.answer: As part of his diplomatic efforts across the kingdom, he coordinates liaisons to outlying Alliance regions, including directing travelers toward Darkshire in Duskwood.

angles.text: For Alliance loyalists, Emissary Taluun serves as an essential diplomatic fixture in Stormwind Keep, coordinating envoys to distant holdings like Darkshire.
